description: Money-free world state after F0-C1 (F0-B events plus the Great Famine, petitions, rights and chapter ends, save v14) for the in-repo cases, from scripts/ledgerBalanceTrace.ts . <case> <ticks> [state]. finalWorldHashWithoutMoney is canonicalStateHash of the final state without treasuryCoin, coinLedger, ledger, money and Building.upkeepUnpaid. F0-B changes the world by design (wet summers bring in 95 % of the crop, the state records events, spec EV-*), so the F0-A world of 55e1522a no longer applies; this pins the F0-C1 world (the state records politics, a petition in 1305-1308 lowers stall fees). The cache must still match the ledger on every tick.
